case.name: Bluebird Demo Assurance Case
case.description: Assurance case for demonstration to Fundamental Research and Turing Showcase

tree.name: G1
tree.description: BluebirdATC at version 0.3 is a sufficiently valid representation of air traffic for its intended use
context: Intended use: inform AI agents on their decision-making

children.name: P1
children.description: In each <window>, BluebirdATC's ingested state carries a complete flight record for at least <q1>% of its aircraft

children.name: P2
children.description: In each <window>, BluebirdATC's ingested aircraft states are internally consistent for at least <q2>% of its aircraft

children.name: S3
children.description: Argument over internal consistency across three dimensions

children.name: P2.2
children.description: Vertical speed reported by aircraft and vertical speed inferred by its change in flight level are consistent to within <q> ft/min

children.name: P2.1
children.description: Ground speed reported by aircraft and ground speed inferred by its change in (latitude, longitude) are consistent to within <q> knots

children.name: P2.3
children.description: Rate of turn reported by aircraft and rate of turn inferred from its change in heading are consistent to within <q> deg/min

children.name: P3
children.description: In each <window>, BluebirdATC's ingested state contains no aircraft squawking an emergency code

children.name: P4
children.description: In each <window>, BluebirdATC's modelled sector holds at most <n> aircraft

children.name: P6
children.description: In each <window>, BluebirdATC's simulated pilot responses to clearances fall within <0-6>s, the range the agents are trained on

children.name: P5
children.description: In each <window>, BluebirdATC's ingested state gives at least <q4>% of its climbing or descending aircraft speed and flight-level combinations achievable for their aircraft type
